title: Constant-factor truthful subadditive combinatorial auctions
area: Algorithmic game theory, mechanism design and fair division
formal: Is there a polynomial-time, polynomial-demand-query truthful-in-expectation mechanism with a universal constant welfare approximation for arbitrary subadditive bidders?
definitions:
There are m distinct indivisible items M=[m] and n buyers. A valuation v:2^M→R_≥0 is normalized by v(∅)=0, monotone under set inclusion, and subadditive: v(S∪T)≤v(S)+v(T) for all S,T⊆M. A feasible allocation gives pairwise disjoint item subsets S_i to the buyers; unsold items are allowed. Welfare is ∑_i v_i(S_i), and OPT(v) is its maximum over feasible allocations. In this oracle variant all valuation values are nonnegative rationals of at most L bits each; the full valuation table is not supplied. For any subset S a value query returns v_i(S). For nonnegative rational item prices p, a demand query returns a bundle maximizing v_i(S)−∑_{j∈S}p_j, choosing the lexicographically least characteristic vector among maximizers. The answer includes the bundle’s value. Query inputs and all payments must have polynomial bit length in n+m+L. A reported type is any valuation in this same domain, and its oracle answers are those of that valuation; arbitrary inconsistent transcripts are not a separate strategy type.

The randomized mechanism outputs disjoint bundles X_i and rational payments P_i. For every true v_i, alternative reported valuation v_i′, and other reports v_−i, require E[v_i(X_i(v_i,v_−i))−P_i(v_i,v_−i)]≥E[v_i(X_i(v_i′,v_−i))−P_i(v_i′,v_−i)]. Also require nonnegative expected utility when reporting truthfully and no positive transfers (P_i≥0 for every outcome). Feasibility is required in every outcome. For every valuation profile, E[∑_i v_i(X_i)]≥α OPT(v) for one absolute α>0. Runtime, number of queries and output length are polynomial in n+m+L in the worst case over coins, excluding the oracle’s internal computation but including writing prices and reading answers. No prior distributions are provided.
answer_criterion: Give a complete Lean-checked proof of the proposition or its negation for the stated model. A proof may be conditional only with an explicit complexity assumption. Universal truthfulness is stronger than required; guarantees for only submodular valuations do not cover this domain.
context: The SODA result breaks a logarithmic welfare-approximation barrier while retaining a factor that grows with the item count.
why: This targets the welfare attainable from strategic bidders with broad complement-free preferences.

import_provenance.original_statement: Can a randomized dominant-strategy truthful mechanism obtain a constant fraction of optimal welfare for arbitrary subadditive bidders using polynomially many demand queries and polynomial computation? Values are worst-case inputs, rather than draws from a known prior, and truthfulness in expectation is allowed.
import_provenance.supplied_caveat: Remark: The demand-query model is essential; value-query lower bounds and prior-dependent prophet mechanisms do not settle this question.

context_blocks.text: The SODA result breaks a logarithmic welfare-approximation barrier while retaining a factor that grows with the item count.

sentences: Bidders may value bundles subadditively without any prior distribution.
The mechanism accesses valuations through exact demand and value queries.
Truthful reporting must maximize each bidder’s expected quasilinear utility.
A single positive welfare factor must hold independently of the number of items.
